y0: The Paralyzed Man Brought by Friends
y1: Some friends brought a paralyzed man lying on a mat to Jesus. Jesus saw their faith and said, 'Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven.'
y2: Then He said, 'Get up, take your mat, and go to your house.' The man got up and went home!
y4: Matthew was a tax collector. Everyone disliked him because he took extra money from people. As Jesus passed by, He said, 'Follow me.' Matthew immediately got up and followed Him.
y5: When Jesus was eating with tax collectors and sinners, people started to complain. Jesus said, 'Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do. I came to call sinners.'
y6: If I Just Touch His Clothes
y7: There was a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years. She thought, 'If I just touch the edge of His clothes, I will be healed.'
y8: When the woman came up behind Him and gently touched it, Jesus turned around and said, 'Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.' At that moment, the woman was healed.
y10: The daughter of Jairus, a synagogue leader, had died. People were crying, but Jesus said, 'The girl isn't dead, but sleeping.'
y11: When Jesus took the girl by the hand, she got up! This news spread all over the land.
verse: 'I didn't come to call the righteous, but sinners.'
prayer: Jesus, thank You for forgiving sins and healing the sick. Thank You for calling me, just as You called Matthew whom nobody liked. Help me to be a person who brings my friends to You too. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: paralyzed. Someone who cannot walk because their body cannot move. His friends brought the paralyzed man to Jesus.
d1: forgive. When your wrongs are no longer remembered, as if they never happened. Jesus forgave his sins.
d2: tax collector. A person who collected taxes for Rome. People hated him because he took extra money. Matthew was a tax collector.
d3: sinner. A person who does wrong by not obeying God's word. Actually, we are all sinners. Jesus came to call sinners.
d4: edge of clothes. The bottom part of a piece of clothing. The woman touched the edge of Jesus's clothes.
d5: sleep. To Jesus, death is like sleep from which you can wake up. The girl isn't dead, but sleeping.
